base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_015 IN ('USFS','BIA','BLM','NPS','FWS','OTHER FEDERAL','UNDEFINED FEDERAL','BOR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       > SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_015 IN ('PRIVATE','STATE OR PRIVATE','STATE','MUNICIPAL/LOCAL','COUNTY','TRIBAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    THEN 'public'
    ELSE 'private'
  END AS land_type
FROM XTB_001;
